name: Radha
description: An elvish barbarian with a mutated spark among Teferi's companions.

timeline.summary: Venser rescues Multani from the Yavimayan rift and Jeska seals it with Radha's spark, which burns out.
timeline.quote: Radha's spark burned out, causing the warlord to lose her potential to become a planeswalker.

citation.text: "Rift", section "Yavimayan rift". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Zhalfir rift is sealed, forever losing Zhalfir from Dominaria.
timeline.quote: sealing the rift closed the nation off from being able to return

citation.text: "Rift", section "Zhalfirin rift". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Under Leshrac's influence, Jeska uses Radha to seal the rift, costing Radha her potential to become a planeswalker.
timeline.quote: Under the influence of Leshrac , Jeska used Radha to seal the rift, causing the warrior to lose her potential to become a planeswalker.

citation.text: "Yavimaya", section "Yavimayan rift". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Radha aids Teferi against the time rifts and drives the Gathans from Keld.
timeline.quote: She aided the planeswalker Teferi during his attempts to save Dominaria from the time rifts

citation.text: "Radha", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jeska asks Radha for help, Radha refuses, and Jeska wins their fight using her latent Phage powers.
timeline.quote: Radha refused, and the two barbarian women fought.

citation.text: "Radha", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jeska takes the tethered Radha to Zhalfir and uses her to channel mana and close the rift, greatly weakening her.
timeline.quote: Radha was greatly weakened by this act.

citation.text: "Radha", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Multani bonds Radha to Yavimaya, restoring her green mana, and Jeska uses her to close the Yavimaya rift.
timeline.quote: Jeska then used Radha again to close the rift in Yavimaya.

citation.text: "Radha", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Radha kills Leshrac's shadow assassin Dinne il-Vec on Madara.
timeline.quote: Radha fought the shadow warrior

citation.text: "Radha", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Radha and Venser accompany Jeska to the Otarian rift, where Jeska's final act closes all rifts.
timeline.quote: Jeska's final act closed the Otarian rift, as well as all others.

citation.text: "Radha", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Radha claims her Keldon heritage on the Mountain, retrieves Astor's daggers and leads the new nation of Keld; her planeswalker spark is permanently extinguished.
timeline.quote: thus she will never be able to ascend.

citation.text: "Radha", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Radha defeats the last Gathan warlord and becomes Grand Warlord of Keld.
timeline.quote: Radha defeated the last Gathan warlord and became the Grand Warlord of Keld.

citation.text: "Radha", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: With the Otarian rift closed by Jeska, the Great Mending begins.
timeline.quote: With the last major rift sealed, the Great Mending began.

citation.text: "Rift", section "Otarian rift". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In Keld Jeska defeats Radha and takes her to use as a mana lens.
timeline.quote: she defeated and took Radha to use her as a mana lens for closing the rifts

citation.text: "Jeska", section "Planeswalker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At Yavimaya a vision from Leshrac makes Jeska immolate Multani's physical form, and she then closes the rift.
timeline.quote: caused Jeska to break the connection and immolate

citation.text: "Jeska", section "Planeswalker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jeska, Venser and Radha teleport into the heart of the Otarian rift.
timeline.quote: Jeska and the two planeswalkers teleported into the heart of the rift

citation.text: "Jeska", section "Planeswalker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: With Teferi's help Radha defeats the Gathan Doyen Greht.
timeline.quote: With the help of Teferi , she became a great warlord in her own right and was able to defeat the Gathan Doyen Greht.

citation.text: "Keld", section "After Twilight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Radha abolishes the taking of slaves as plunder.
timeline.quote: The taking of slaves as plunder has been abolished, and Keldons now learn industries and crafts.

citation.text: "Keld", section "After Twilight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Leshrac takes over Jeska's mind and uses her and Radha to close the rifts in Yavimaya and Zhalfir.
timeline.quote: Leshrac managed to get hold of Jeska's mind

citation.text: "Leshrac", section "Leshrac's Return". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Multani bonds Radha to the forest, restoring her green mana, and hypnotizes Jeska.
timeline.quote: He also created a new bond between Radha and the forest

citation.text: "Multani", section "Temporal Crisis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jeska awakens and blasts Multani's physical body to smithereens, then uses Radha and his mask to seal the rift, diminishing his essence.
timeline.quote: Jeska awakened and blasted Multani's physical body to smithereens.

citation.text: "Multani", section "Temporal Crisis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jeska uses part of Radha's soul to close the Zhalfir rift, severing Zhalfir from the Multiverse.
timeline.quote: severing Zhalfir from the Multiverse entirely

citation.text: "Temporal Crisis of Dominaria", section "Resolution". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jeska burns out Radha's inherited spark, closing the Yavimaya rift but temporarily destroying Multani.
timeline.quote: burning out the spark Radha had unknowingly inherited

citation.text: "Temporal Crisis of Dominaria", section "Resolution". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi meets Radha at the rift; she agrees to join him in exchange for ancient Keldon knowledge.
timeline.quote: Radha agrees to join Teferi

citation.text: "Time Spiral (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In Urborg the group meets Venser and Teferi senses both he and Radha have planeswalker sparks different from his own.
timeline.quote: Teferi can discern that both Radha and Venser have the planeswalker spark

citation.text: "Time Spiral (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Venser's demonstration of the ambulator makes the rift react violently, and Teferi planeswalks into it; the whole group is pulled through the rift.
timeline.quote: the entire group is pulled into the rift falling through cracks in their reality

citation.text: "Time Spiral (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Within the rift the group witnesses the events that caused Dominaria's rifts, including the Sylex and the obliteration of Tolaria.
timeline.quote: they witness the devastating events in Dominaria's history that caused the rifts plaguing the plane

citation.text: "Time Spiral (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A disembodied voice tricks Venser and uses his and Radha's latent sparks to regain a body, revealing itself as Nicol Bolas.
timeline.quote: revealing itself to be Nicol Bolas

citation.text: "Time Spiral (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Radha defeats the Gathan warlord and becomes the new Warlord of Keld, shifting her rift connection to Keld.
timeline.quote: she becomes the new Warlord of Keld

citation.text: "Time Spiral (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Venser and Teferi's companions are swept through the rifts and deposited above Madara, where Radha faces the cat dragons.
timeline.quote: finally being deposited upon the cliffs overlooking the shores of Madara

citation.text: "Venser", section "The Mending". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi challenges Bolas to a duel and is demolished; Radha talks Bolas out of taking more than their guard Aprem's life, and Bolas departs with a threat to Kamigawa.
timeline.quote: with a dire threat against the inhabitants of Kamigawa , Bolas departed

citation.text: "Venser", section "The Mending". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jeska studies the rifts, uses Radha as her tool, and is stopped by Venser and company at great cost to Radha's spark and Zhalfir.
timeline.quote: only after grievous damage had been done to Radha's spark and Zhalfir

citation.text: "Venser", section "The Mending". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jeska casts Venser and Radha back and sacrifices herself, and the Mending takes place.
timeline.quote: with that final sacrifice, the Mending took place

citation.text: "Venser", section "The Mending". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In Skyshroud Freyalise uses the slivers' hive mind to beat back the Phyrexians and asks Jhoira to find Radha.
timeline.quote: She requests that Jhoira find Radha in the Pardic mountains

citation.text: "Planar Chaos (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jeska questions Jhoira, Venser and Teferi, then goes to Otaria where Leshrac proposes using Venser's and Radha's sparks to close the rifts.
timeline.quote: Leshrac proposes that Jeska use Venser's and Radha ’s latent planeswalker sparks to channel mana and close them

citation.text: "Future Sight (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jeska defeats Radha in a duel at Keld and takes her unconscious.
timeline.quote: Jeska defeats Radha in a duel and takes the unconscious elf with her.

citation.text: "Future Sight (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jeska uses Radha as a buffer to seal the Zhalfirin rift, leaving Radha near death and Zhalfir lost.
timeline.quote: Jeska is past the point of no return and completes the sealing, leaving Radha close to death.

citation.text: "Future Sight (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jeska seals the Yavimayan rift through Radha and Multani's mask, leaving the mask inert; Jhoira buries it.
timeline.quote: Jhoira buries Multani's mask in the hopes that he can someday be revived

citation.text: "Future Sight (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jeska sacrifices herself to seal the last rift over Otaria, and the Mending alters the planeswalker spark.
timeline.quote: Upon its sealing, the nature of the planeswalker spark is inherently altered in the process known as the Mending .

citation.text: "Future Sight (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The group disbands; Radha returns to Keld, Teferi to Jamuraa, Jhoira seeks Jodah, and Venser makes his first planeswalk.
timeline.quote: Venser, now a planeswalker in his own right, makes his first planeswalk into the unknown.

citation.text: "Future Sight (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jhoira recalls learning from Radha how to talk sense into Keldons.
timeline.quote: I learned that from Radha.

citation.text: Befuddle (Dominaria, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Grand Warlord Radha declares the Keldons do what is best for them, not for the past.
timeline.quote: We are Keldons!"

citation.text: Warlord's Fury (Dominaria, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Radha is captured by the Cabal and forced to fight in the Stronghold's pit; Gideon Jura's arrival lets her escape, and she kills Whisper.
timeline.quote: During the escape, she ended up killing Whisper .

citation.text: "Radha", section "Fighting the Cabal". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Radha helps Gideon and Chandra find the Blackblade and organizes the spirits of Urborg against the Cabal.
timeline.quote: and organized the spirits of Urborg in their attack on the Cabal .

citation.text: "Radha", section "Fighting the Cabal". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gideon joins a back-to-back group led by the warrior Radha.
timeline.quote: She thrust her sword through the chest of a black-robed cultist and said, "I'm Radha."

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Radha throws a knife into Whisper's eye, killing her after Gideon's shield deflects her spell.
timeline.quote: Then suddenly a blade blossomed in Whisper's right eye.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Radha agrees to help Gideon and Chandra after hearing the Weatherlight has been restored.
timeline.quote: "Then I'll come with you." Radha turned to the others.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Chandra blasts open the treasury doors with fire.
timeline.quote: Her fire washed over it, white-hot, and burned away chains, the sigils powering the guard spells, and the door itself.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Gideon, Chandra and Radha find the Blackblade in the fourth treasury vault and fight through the Stronghold's hall as the undead overwhelm the Cabal.
timeline.quote: They had found the weapon inside the fourth treasury vault, mounted on a stone plinth like a trophy.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Karn and Ajani warn Jodah, Jaya and the summit leaders that the Phyrexians have returned, but are met with doubt.
timeline.quote: The Phyrexians have returned to Dominaria.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Sand in the Hourglass" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Radha and Aron are about to sign the peace when Teferi arrives with news that the Phyrexians were on Kamigawa.
timeline.quote: "It's the Phyrexians—they were on Kamigawa."

citation.text: "Episode 2: Sand in the Hourglass" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: The news of the Phyrexian threat unsettles the summit, and the signing of the peace is left uncertain.
timeline.quote: Radha and Aron had not signed—and this made it seem like they wouldn't.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Sand in the Hourglass" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Karn presents the caged Phyrexian bird to the negotiators; three Benalish knights burst open into Phyrexian monsters and break the table.
timeline.quote: Three of the Benalish knights exploded outward from their armor.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Sand in the Hourglass" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Radha and the Keldons withdraw and lock the Phyrexians into the room with the planeswalkers, who fight them.
timeline.quote: The brass double doors slammed shut

citation.text: "Episode 2: Sand in the Hourglass" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: The Golden Argosy arrives; Radha and her Keldon warriors board the dreadnought and kill it.
timeline.quote: Hundreds of Keldon warriors leapt from the ship

citation.text: "Episode 4: A Brutal Blow" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Jaya, Danitha, Radha and the Keldon and Benalish warriors pour from the Argosy; Jaya burns Phyrexians with fire and lightning.
timeline.quote: Keldon warriors and Benalish knights poured from the Argosy onto the Mana Rig's decks.

citation.work: Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind
citation.text: "Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Jodah portals Danitha, Radha, Meria and the troops to safety and steps through his final portal.
timeline.quote: Jodah pulled up a portal and threw Danitha, Radha, and Meria into it

citation.work: Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind
citation.text: "Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Radha declares she is coming for Sheoldred.
timeline.quote: "Enough warm-up. I'm coming for you, Sheoldred!"

citation.text: Radha, Coalition Warlord (Dominaria United, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Radha searches for Astor's tomb in the Necropolis and finds only his twin kukris.
timeline.quote: she found no corpse in his tomb, only his twin kukris

citation.text: "Astor", section "Astor's Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During Sheoldred's invasion the Golden Argosy returns carrying Astor, restored to his senses after centuries, and he fights his old foes again.
timeline.quote: the Golden Argosy returned, carrying Astor aboard

citation.text: "Astor", section "Second Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the Oyster Bay summit Aron, found compleated, is killed by his daughter Danitha.
timeline.quote: Houses Capashen and Tarmula joined to rescue Aron, but when it was discovered that he had already been compleated, he was killed by his daughter, Danitha .

citation.text: "Benalia", section "Dominaria United". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On Aerona Jaya fights compleated Ertai and Aron Capashen and is rescued by Radha, then is killed by compleated Ajani at the Mana Rig.
timeline.quote: She was killed by a compleated Ajani Goldmane at the Battle of the Mana Rig .

citation.text: "Jaya Ballard", section "Dominaria United". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A peace summit at Oyster Bay between Radha's Keldons and Aron Capashen's Benalish is interrupted by Karn and Teferi's warning and revealed Phyrexian sleeper agents.
timeline.quote: The summit was interrupted when the planeswalkers Karn and Teferi revealed the threat of a New Phyrexian invasion and several of the Benalish knights turned out to be Phyrexian sleeper agents .

citation.text: "Keld", section "Dominaria United". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Radha leads the Keldon delegation at the Oyster Bay peace summit, interrupted when Karn and Teferi reveal the Phyrexian threat and Phyrexian sleeper agents among the Benalish knights.
timeline.quote: Radha led the Keldon delegation at the peace summit at Oyster Bay

citation.text: "Radha", section "Dominaria United". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Radha fights in defense of Dominaria during the New Phyrexian Invasion.
timeline.quote: Radha fought in defense of Dominaria during the

citation.text: "Radha", section "Dominaria United". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Radha extinguishes her spark closing time rifts during the Temporal crisis of Dominaria.
timeline.quote: Extinguished the spark closing time rifts

citation.text: "List of Planeswalker characters", section "Potential Planeswalkers who never ignited". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
